dct_description_sm: The data are from a coordinated mesocosm experiment that was conducted at 16 sites in Canada, USA, Sweden, and Spain in 2017. It includes water chemistry, zooplankton and chlorophyll a concentrations. Experiments employed a gradient design to assess the impact of increasing chloride concentrations on plankton communities. Experiments range for approximately 6 weeks.
